title: 武外乒乓球校队参加八校联赛
title_en: WFLS Table Tennis School Team at the Eight-School League
excerpt:
校队成员祁子傲、陈瑜萱、魏罗瑞、李南熠、任峻贤代表外高赴华师一，参加了由华师一乒乓球社组织的的八校联赛
（华中师范大学第一附属中学，湖北省实验中学，武汉外国语学校，武汉市第二中学，武汉中学，武汉市第十四中学，武汉市洪山高级中学，武汉成丰学校）
最终遗憾止步第一轮
excerpt_en:
School team members QI Ziao, CHEN Yuxuan, WEI Luorui, LI Nanyi and REN Junxian represented WFLS at the No. 1 High School Attached to Central China Normal University, taking part in the eight-school league organised by that school's table tennis club
(The No. 1 High School Attached to Central China Normal University, Hubei Provincial Experimental High School, Wuhan Foreign Languages School, Wuhan No. 2 High School, Wuhan High School, Wuhan No. 14 High School, Wuhan Hongshan High School, Wuhan Chengfeng School)
They were unfortunately knocked out in the first round
